You hear boots on the stairs. Then a voice outside your apartment door: "SWAT! Open the door!"
Climb out the bathroom window
You squeezed through the bathroom window and dropped onto a dumpster in the alley.
A SWAT officer was waiting under the window.
Barricade the door and fight
You held them off long enough to slip out the fire escape.
The door exploded inward. The SWAT team opened fire.
Hide in the ceiling
You hid above the ceiling tiles for six hours. They never looked up.
A K9 dog started barking at the ceiling.
Open the door with your hands up
You opened the door with your hands up. Twenty rifles were pointed at your chest.
You turn a corner and there's a police roadblock ahead. Every car is being searched.
Make a U-turn
You whipped the car around and disappeared down a side road.
Three patrol cars boxed you in before you finished turning.
Floor it through the barricade
You smashed through the barricade and lost them on the highway.
Officers opened fire on your windshield.
police at a roadblock
Bluff your way through
You smiled, showed a fake ID, and the officer waved you through.
The officer looked at your face, then at the poster taped to the barricade.
Pull over and surrender
You pulled over and put your hands on the steering wheel.
You're eating at a diner when two men in windbreakers sit down at the counter. The backs of their jackets say U.S. MARSHALS.
Slip out through the kitchen
You walked through the kitchen like you worked there and out the back door.
A third marshal was waiting by the back door.
Grab a steak knife
You fought your way out and stole a car from the parking lot.
Both marshals drew their guns at the same time.
Stay calm and finish your coffee
They ate their pancakes and left. They never recognized you.
One of them finished his coffee, stood up, and said your real name.
Walk over and give yourself up
You sat down next to them and said, "I'm tired." They cuffed you right there at the counter.
A police helicopter's spotlight swings across the field you're crossing at night.
Run for the tree line
You made it into the woods before the spotlight found you.
The spotlight locked onto you, and the dogs weren't far behind.
Lie flat in the tall grass
You lay still for two hours. The helicopter gave up.
The thermal camera saw right through the grass.
Shoot at the helicopter
The helicopter pulled away, and you disappeared into the dark.
The ground team followed the muzzle flash.
a police tactical team
Stand up with your hands raised
You stood up in the spotlight and raised your hands.
You're hiding in a cheap motel room. Through the curtains you see police cars pulling into the parking lot with their lights off.
Sneak out through the room next door
You broke through the connecting door and walked out of the next room in a bathrobe.
The room next door was full of officers.
Take the motel clerk hostage
You held the clerk long enough to get to a car.
A sniper across the street took the shot.
a police sniper
Hide in the laundry room
You hid in a laundry cart until they left.
A maid screamed when she found you.
Turn on the TV and wait
You turned on the news, saw your own face, and waited for them to knock.

Stay in line and hope
The agent stamped your passport without looking up. You're out of the country.
The agent scanned your face and a red light started flashing.
Leave the line and try the river
You crossed the river at night and made it to the other side.
Border patrol found you halfway across.
Rush the gate
You ran the gate and made it across.
Border agents opened fire.
Turn yourself in to the agent
You handed the agent your fake passport and said, "You're going to want to call someone."
A cashier at the grocery store keeps glancing from you to her phone. You can see your mugshot on the screen.
Leave everything and walk out
You left your cart and walked out. By the time police arrived, you were gone.
Police were already pulling into the parking lot.
Pay and act natural
You paid in cash and smiled. She decided she was wrong.
She called the police the second you walked out.
Threaten her
She was too scared to call. You got away.
An off-duty cop in line drew his gun.
an off-duty police officer
You sat down on the curb outside and waited.
You're hiding in the woods when you hear dogs barking. They're getting closer.
Run through the creek to lose the scent
You waded downstream for an hour. The dogs lost your scent.
The dogs picked up your trail on the other bank.
The dogs ran right under you. The handlers moved on.
The dogs circled your tree and wouldn't stop barking.
Fight the dogs off
You fought off the dogs and limped deeper into the woods.
The handlers caught up and opened fire.
police K9 handlers
Come out with your hands up
You walked out of the woods with your hands up before the dogs reached you.
You're at a bus station with a one-way ticket. Two transit cops are walking down the line checking faces.
Board early through the back
You slipped onto the bus through the back door. It pulled away with you on it.
The driver called the cops over.
Hide in the bathroom until they pass
They checked every face in line but never checked the bathroom.
One of them kicked open your stall door.
Make a run for it through the crowd
You disappeared into the crowd and out the back exit.
One officer drew his weapon as you ran.
Walk up to the officers
You walked up to the officers and held out your wrists.
You're hiding out in a cabin in the woods. You wake up to a voice on a megaphone: "This is the FBI. The cabin is surrounded."
Escape through the root cellar
The old root cellar had a tunnel to the woods. You were gone before they breached.
Agents were waiting at the other end of the tunnel.
You somehow made it into the woods during the chaos.
Set the cabin on fire and run
You slipped away in the smoke.
Agents tackled you as you ran out of the smoke.
Walk out with your hands up
You walked out onto the porch with your hands up. Dozens of agents moved in.
